purpose: Discover whether two legal placements of a required pre-Join governance checkpoint have stable bidirectional performance reversals.
governed_query: Apply a cheap query predicate and a sensitive-value policy predicate, retain only permitted matching rows, and aggregate after a cross-domain Join.

candidate_semantics.policy_first_narrow_checkpoint: Evaluate policy on all rows, drop the sensitive value, then materialize a narrow checkpoint before applying the query predicate and Join.
candidate_semantics.query_first_raw_checkpoint: Apply the cheap query predicate first, materialize remaining raw sensitive values, then evaluate policy before Join. This candidate is available only when raw checkpoint materialization is permitted.

governance_rule: Candidate feasibility is evaluated before cost. A no-raw-materialization policy rejects query_first_raw_checkpoint regardless of latency.

predeclared_outcomes.stable_bidirectional_reversal: At least one scenario confidence-authorizes policy-first and at least one confidence-authorizes query-first.
predeclared_outcomes.one_stable_direction: Only one candidate ever receives confidence-authorized superiority; do not claim adaptive value.
predeclared_outcomes.no_stable_direction: No candidate clears the confidence boundary; redesign timing or candidate semantics before model fitting.

boundaries: No optimizer is trained in EA-1.
No result is deleted as an outlier.
EA-1 is development discovery, not final holdout evidence.
Query templates and thresholds are frozen before execution.
